review_notes: I read the whole file with the simp-interface rubric in mind. It has no @[simp] declarations of its own. The only attribute changes are the `attribute [-simp]` line at the top and `attribute [local instance]`. The simp-related problems I found are two missing normal-form lemmas. One is the coercion of `Units.map (algebraMap ..).toMonoidHom (Units.mk0 ξ _)`, which the file re-simplifies with the same lemma list in about six places. The other is the home-made `adele_fst_mul`/`adele_snd_mul` rfl lemmas, which duplicate the existing simp lemmas `Prod.fst_mul`/`Prod.snd_mul` and are used in long `rw` chains. I did not run Lean and I claim no loops or simp failures. I did not check how the file's `simp [hx, ...]` calls interact with the extra simp lemmas Mathlib provides for ring homs. Other duplication, such as the three copies of the 'finitely many v with valuation ≠ 1' lemma, is outside this rubric.

findings.problem: The canonical-form fact `((Units.map (algebraMap F (AdeleRing (𝓞 F) F)).toMonoidHom (Units.mk0 ξ h) : (AdeleRing (𝓞 F) F)ˣ) : AdeleRing (𝓞 F) F) = algebraMap F (AdeleRing (𝓞 F) F) ξ` has no dedicated lemma. Instead the same five-lemma list (`Units.coe_map, RingHom.toMonoidHom_eq_coe, MonoidHom.coe_coe, Units.val_mk0`) is repeated in at least six `simp`/`simpa` calls, at lines 1113, 1180, 1918, 2052, 2592 and 2659. Some of these are bare `simp [...]`/`simpa [...]`, which pull in the whole default simp set. The `T1frq` unfolding is also repeated by hand.
findings.proposed_change: Add one private lemma, for example `coe_map_toMonoidHom_mk0 (ξ : F) (h : ξ ≠ 0) : ((Units.map (algebraMap F (AdeleRing (𝓞 F) F)).toMonoidHom (Units.mk0 ξ h) : (AdeleRing (𝓞 F) F)ˣ) : AdeleRing (𝓞 F) F) = algebraMap F (AdeleRing (𝓞 F) F) ξ`, proved once by the existing `simp only` list. Optionally add `T1frq_eq : T1frq F ξ y = algebraMap F _ ξ * y` as an unfolding lemma. Then replace the repeated lists with `simp only [T1frq_eq, coe_map_toMonoidHom_mk0, Units.val_mul]`. Marking it `@[simp]` is only worthwhile if the file's bare `simp`/`simpa` calls are kept; otherwise use it in `simp only`.
findings.benefit: This gives one canonical normal form for the global-element-to-idele coercion. The six call sites become shorter and no longer depend on the default simp set, so they are less brittle to simp-set changes and clearer to read.

findings.declaration: adele_fst_mul / adele_snd_mul and their uses in snd_mul_dilation_mul, ringEquiv_mixedSpace_fst_mul_dilation_mul, ringEquiv_mixedSpace_snd_mul_dilation_mul
findings.excerpt: private theorem adele_fst_mul (a b : AdeleRing (𝓞 F) F) : (a * b).1 = a.1 * b.1 := rfl
findings.problem: `adele_fst_mul` and `adele_snd_mul` just restate `Prod.fst_mul` and `Prod.snd_mul` for `AdeleRing`, which is a product type. They are not simp lemmas, so every use repeats them in a `rw` chain: five `adele_snd_mul` at line 418 and five `adele_fst_mul` at lines 436 and 447, each followed by five `map_mul`. The same proofs already call `simp only [Prod.fst_mul, Pi.mul_apply, hz]` at line 438. The rewrites are therefore split across a manual `rw` and a `simp only` that already contains the canonical lemma. The extra lemmas also compete with `Prod.fst_mul` for the same redex.
findings.proposed_change: Delete `adele_fst_mul` and `adele_snd_mul`. In the three proofs use a single `simp only [Units.val_mul, Prod.fst_mul, Prod.snd_mul, map_mul, Pi.mul_apply, hz]` (or `Prod.snd_mul` plus `hz2, one_mul` in `snd_mul_dilation_mul`) in place of the repeated `rw [... ×5]` chains. `snd_mul_dilation_mul` could do the same.
findings.benefit: This removes duplicate local lemmas that shadow the library's canonical simp lemmas. It removes the fragile counted `rw` repetition, which breaks if the term shape changes. It also uses one rewrite mechanism instead of a `rw` followed by a `simp only`.
